visual_elements.description: Left-to-right block diagram of the TI TIDA-00176 Sin/Cos encoder interface. (1) Far left: cyan-blue rectangle (MCU peripherals) containing three stacked white sub-blocks: 'Fine Angle: atan(A/B) / → Option 1: 16 bit', 'Fine Angle: atan(A/B) / → Option 2: 12-bit', 'Coarse Angle / Incremental count'; on its right edge, small labels 'SPI' (with a tiny chip icon), '12-bit ADC', 'eQEP'. (2) Vertical gray box 'Host MCU Interface' with three labeled connections entering from the blue box: 'SPI' (top), 'A, B / Analog' (middle), 'A, B, / TTL' (bottom). (3) Large light-green container with dashed green border, white tag 'TIDA-00176' at its top-right, containing: white box '16-bit high-res path' above an orange 'Dual ADC' block followed by a green triangle amplifier, outputs labeled 'A+, A-, B+, B-'; white box 'Analog path' with green triangle amplifier, outputs 'A+, A-, B+, B-'; a green comparator block with hysteresis symbol feeding the label 'Comparators', outputs 'R+, R-'; at the bottom an orange 'Power Supplies' block fed from the left by a small gray box '24 V', with output arrows '5 V' and '3.3 V' to the right and the note 'Encoder Supply: 5.25 V' below. (4) Vertical gray box 'Encoder connector' collecting the A+, A-, B+, B-, R+, R- signal lines. (5) White rounded rectangle with thick green border containing: orange box 'Differential Sine and Cosine A+, A-, B+, B-, and Marker R+, R-' at top; curved twisted-pair wires labeled 'A+, A-, B+, B-, R+, R-' with note 'Shielded twisted pairs cable, up to 50...150m'; gray 'AC Motor' illustration at top-right; orange box 'Sin/Cos Encoder' at bottom coupled to the motor. Arrows flow left-to-right from the MCU interface through the three signal paths to the Encoder connector and out to the Sin/Cos Encoder on the motor.

Far right, place a white rounded rectangle with a thick green (#00B050) border containing: an orange (#F79646) box 'Differential Sine and Cosine A+, A-, B+, B-, and Marker R+, R-' at the top; curved black twisted-pair wire lines labeled 'A+, A-, B+, B-, R+, R-' with the note 'Shielded twisted pairs cable, up to 50...150m'; a gray (#808080/#BFBFBF) AC motor illustration (body with cooling fins and connection box) labeled 'AC Motor' at the top-right; and an orange (#F79646) box 'Sin/Cos Encoder' at the bottom coupled to the motor.
12. Draw left-to-right signal-flow arrows from the Host MCU Interface (step 8) through the three signal paths (step 9) to the Encoder connector (step 10) and onward to the Sin/Cos Encoder box (step 11).
13. Outside the white panel, to its left (slide x ~15-22%, y ~55-65%), place a thick red (#C00000) block arrow pointing LEFT with a red bold label 'Position (Angle)' directly beneath it.
